summary: Full end-to-end verification of the new 'Importa episodio da Spotify' feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass on POST /api/admin/podcasts/spotify-episodes (Spotify show URL + direct RSS feed, both return same 20 episodes with direct .mp3 URLs on host d3ctxlq1ktw2nl.cloudfront.net and NEVER open.spotify.com; auth-gate returns 403 without token and with bad token; empty source returns 400; podcast_title correctly contains 'Pescatori di Uomini'). Frontend UI (mobile 390x844): email login as admin (pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / Admin1234!) succeeds -> auto-redirect to /admin; /admin/podcasts/pod_51a4b0509027 shows green 'Importa episodio da Spotify' button (testID pod-import-spotify); modal opens with saved URL, 'Carica episodi' renders 20 episodes (spotify-ep-0..19); tapping spotify-ep-0 closes the modal, fills Titolo ('S3. Episodio 2: Sono Una Brava Persona'), Descrizione, Categoria (Predicazione), Copertina, audio_url (direct cloudfront .mp3) and Durata (00:04:03), and shows the success message 'Episodio importato da Spotify — controlla i campi e salva.'. Guest flow: /podcast/pod_51a4b0509027 shows the PdU player button 'Riproduci' (testID pod-detail-play) with 0 iframes on the page — NO Spotify embed is rendered when audio_url is a direct .mp3 (as expected because detectProvider returns null for cloudfront URLs).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 7555 lines — should be split into modules (not related to this feature but a growing concern).
SpotifyImportModal loading state has no timeout; if backend hangs the user cannot cancel. Non-blocking, acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: None — used the already-seeded admin user (pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it) and the existing podcast pod_51a4b0509027 with direct .mp3 audio_url.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POST /api/admin/podcasts/spotify-episodes accepts either a Spotify show URL (https://open.spotify.com/show/...) or a direct RSS feed (https://anchor.fm/s/.../podcast/rss). Backend unwraps Anchor's /play/<id>/<encoded-mp3> enclosure to a raw cloudfront .mp3 URL. Frontend detectProvider() must NOT match cloudfront URLs (otherwise the detail page would render the Spotify iframe instead of the PdU player) — confirmed working.
rca_of_issue: N/A — new feature verified working end-to-end.
